title: 规制开放与国际专利申请：以《专利法》TRIPS协调为例
authors: 王星媛, 盛伟, 杨洪娜
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 健全与国际规则相衔接的知识产权保护机制是推进高水平制度型开放的重要内容。本文立足于我国《专利法》向TRIPS的三次协调这一规制开放的客观事实,使用广义双重差分模型考察知识产权规制开放对中国国际专利申请的影响。研究发现：《专利法》TRIPS协调通过同族专利挤出、专利意识强化及自主创新激励三条路径影响中国国际专利申请;1992年《专利法》TRIPS协调以同族专利挤出效应为主,整体阻碍国际专利申请,而2000和2008年《专利法》TRIPS协调,专利意识强化与自主创新激励效应显著,整体促进国际专利申请。在技术深度密集、贸易活跃度高、高技术价值以及高联合创新水平的行业和低专利集中度的目的地中,以上政策效果更为突出。此外,仅第三次协调对国际专利释放“提质”效应,但未实现“增效”目标。本文系统评估了我国《专利法》TRIPS协调的政策成效,为深入推进我国高水平制度型开放与实施创新驱动发展战略提供了政策启示。

title: Reputation and Competitive Selection
title_zh: 声誉与竞争性选择
authors: Deb, Joyee, Fanning, Jack
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We demonstrate how selection in competitive markets can impede longrun reputational incentives. In our model, competent firms can exert costly effort to improve expected product quality, but inept firms cannot. With low entry barriers, we show competent firms cannot persistently exert effort, despite bounded memory. Such effort would cause consumers to select firms based on reputations for competence, eventually selecting a monopolist with arbitrarily high reputation, which has no incentive for effort. More generally, reputation-based selection rules out long-run effort, which then undermines the basis for such selection. Intermediate entry barriers provide stronger reputational incentives than low or high barriers.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了竞争市场中的选择机制如何阻碍长期声誉激励。在我们的模型中，有能力的企业可以通过付出高昂努力来提升预期产品质量，而无能的企业则无法做到。在低进入壁垒条件下，我们发现即使存在有限记忆，有能力的企业也无法持续付出努力。这种努力会导致消费者基于企业能力声誉进行选择，最终筛选出具有任意高声誉的垄断者，而该垄断者缺乏付出努力的动机。更一般地，基于声誉的选择机制排除了长期努力的可能性，而这反过来又削弱了此类选择机制的基础。中等程度的进入壁垒比低壁垒或高壁垒能提供更强的声誉激励。

title: Carbon Pricing and Investment
title_zh: 碳定价与投资
authors: James R Brown, Gustav Martinsson, Per Strömberg, Christian Thomann, James R Brown; Gustav Martinsson; Per Strömberg; Christian Thomann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How does carbon pricing affect investment in brown firms? During the period 2000–2019, the effective cost of emitting carbon rose by about 400 percent for Swedish manufacturing firms. Despite lower operating margins, high-emission firms significantly increased both total capital investment and the share of investment dedicated to abatement. The response is concentrated among firms with strong internal financial capacity. We find no comparable investment increase in lower-emitting firms or in high-emission industries outside of Sweden. Our results show that pricing CO2 emissions at a sufficiently high level can incentivize brown firms to make green investments.
abstract_zh: 碳定价如何影响棕色企业的投资？在2000年至2019年间，瑞典制造业企业的有效碳排放成本上升了约400%。尽管运营利润率下降，高排放企业仍显著增加了总资本投资以及用于减排的投资份额。这一反应集中在内部财务能力较强的企业中。我们在低排放企业或瑞典以外的高排放行业中未发现类似的投资增长。研究结果表明，将二氧化碳排放定价在足够高的水平，能够激励棕色企业进行绿色投资。

title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 看似锚定的通胀预期
authors: Ulrike Malmendier, Stefan Nagel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 通常被引用来表明通胀预期已更好锚定的实证证据包括：预期对通胀意外冲击的敏感性随时间推移而下降，尤其是在采用通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与基于经验的学习模型一致——在该模型中，个体仅依据其一生经历的实际通胀历史进行学习，而无需将预期锚定于公布的官方通胀目标。在该模型下，新冠疫情前数十年间低短期通胀持续性的长期经历，使得长期预期对通胀意外冲击不敏感，这与实证锚定检验中观察到的模式相吻合。数据还验证了基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测：自20世纪80年代以来，年轻群体对通胀意外冲击敏感性的下降幅度最大。对低通胀持续性经历的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升期间保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，若个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外冲击的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能低于普遍认知。

abstract: Lack of market transparency can impair the liquidity provision of nonstandard liquidity suppliers and make liquidity demand increasing in illiquidity. This can yield strategic complementarities and induce multiple equilibria. Then an initial dearth of liquidity may degenerate into a liquidity rout (as in a “flash crash”), and traders faced with the largest cost of trading are those trading more intensely at equilibrium. An increase in order flow transparency and/or in the mass of dealers who are in the market at all times has a positive impact on total welfare. (JEL G12, G14, G41)

title: Does Central Bank Transparency Curb Foreign Exchange Vulnerability?
title_zh: 中央银行透明度能否抑制外汇脆弱性？
authors: MUHAMMAD AFTAB, KATE PHYLAKTIS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract This study investigates the impact of central bank transparency (CBT) on foreign exchange market vulnerability, measured by exchange market pressure (EMP). Using panel autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) analysis on a sample of 32 countries, the results show that greater CBT significantly reduces EMP. The findings remain robust after controlling for U.S. monetary policy uncertainty, economic policy uncertainty, and financial development. However, no evidence is found that CBT becomes more effective during periods of heightened uncertainty. Further analysis indicates that exchange rate flexibility and financial integration strengthen the mitigating effect of CBT on EMP in emerging markets but not in developed markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行透明度（CBT）对外汇市场脆弱性（以汇率市场压力（EMP）衡量）的影响。通过对32个国家的面板自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析，结果表明，更高的中央银行透明度显著降低了汇率市场压力。在控制美国货币政策不确定性、经济政策不确定性和金融发展水平后，该结论依然稳健。然而，未发现中央银行透明度在不确定性加剧时期更为有效的证据。进一步分析表明，汇率灵活性和金融一体化增强了中央银行透明度对新兴市场汇率市场压力的缓解效应，但在发达市场中并不显著。

title: There Will Be Liquidity! But Will There Be Transmission?
title_zh: 流动性将存在！但传导会实现吗？
authors: Gregorio Impavido & Shuyu Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of voluntary and involuntary excess liquidity on monetary policy effectiveness and inflation in Kazakhstan. Consistent with first-principles predictions, we find that voluntary liquidity held for precautionary motives is (i) negatively related to the opportunity cost of holding liquid assets and to the level of mandatory reserve requirements; (ii) positively related to average liquidity outflows, proxied by transactional demand for cash; and (iii) ambiguously affected by the magnitude and volatility of the business cycle. We further show that higher voluntary liquidity weakens monetary policy transmission and increases exchange rate pass-through to inflation. In contrast, involuntary liquidity hampers monetary policy effectiveness no matter its level and it increases average inflation primarily through its influence on the formation of inflation expectations. Overall, the results suggest that reforms aimed at reducing both forms of liquidity would enhance monetary policy effectiveness and, ceteris paribus, reduce inflation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了哈萨克斯坦自愿性与非自愿性超额流动性对货币政策有效性和通货膨胀的影响。与基本原理预测一致，我们发现：出于预防性动机持有的自愿性流动性（i）与持有流动性资产的机会成本及法定准备金要求水平呈负相关；（ii）与以现金交易需求为代理变量的平均流动性流出呈正相关；（iii）受经济周期幅度和波动性的影响具有模糊性。我们进一步证明，较高的自愿性流动性会削弱货币政策传导机制，并增强汇率传递对通货膨胀的影响。相比之下，无论非自愿性流动性水平高低，其均会阻碍货币政策有效性，并主要通过影响通胀预期形成机制推高平均通胀水平。总体而言，研究结果表明，旨在减少两种形式流动性的改革将提升货币政策有效性，并在其他条件不变的情况下降低通货膨胀。

title: Nowcasting Country-Level Trade Estimates Using IMF PortWatch
title_zh: 使用IMF PortWatch进行国家层面贸易估算的即时预测
authors: Mr. Serkan Arslanalp & Oliver Exton & Chang Gao & Mario Saraiva & Ms. Parisa Kamali & Alessandra Sozzi & Jasper Verschuur
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops high frequency trade estimates at the country level by applying nowcasting methodologies to satellite-based big data on vessel movements sourced from IMF PortWatch. The approach provides a timely estimate of monthly trade at the country level that can be produced and released within 7 working days. The paper validates the nowcasting trade estimates against official data for an initial wave of countries representing advanced economies, emerging markets and small island developing states: Brazil, Jamaica, Japan, Samoa, and the United States. The nowcasting methodology produces trade estimates that perform well compared to the official statistics, with the best fit for advanced economies and large emerging markets. The paper identifies key complementary information to improve the presented nowcasting methodology to develop country trade estimates. The paper also considers an application to estimates of U.S. imports during a period of elevated trade tensions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将即时预测方法应用于国际货币基金组织港口观察（IMF PortWatch）提供的基于卫星的船舶移动大数据，开发了国家层面的高频贸易估算。该方法可在7个工作日内生成并发布国家层面的月度贸易及时估算。本文以首批涵盖发达经济体、新兴市场和小岛屿发展中国家的国家（巴西、牙买加、日本、萨摩亚和美国）为对象，将即时预测贸易估算与官方数据进行验证。结果表明，该即时预测方法生成的贸易估算与官方统计数据拟合良好，其中对发达经济体和大型新兴市场的拟合效果最佳。本文识别了改进现有即时预测方法以完善国家贸易估算的关键补充信息，并进一步探讨了该方法在贸易紧张局势加剧时期对美国进口估算的应用。

abstract: Abstract This study analyses the records in the Cairo geniza , the distribution of Chinese ceramics, the reports of travellers (this is the best‐known, but least important, dataset), and the discussions of the Portuguese regarding how best to exploit pepper in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. This is then set against what evidence there is from Kerala itself. It emerges that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance. The Kerala economy was based on rice, and it remained so. The article therefore contributes to the growing historiography which stresses internal regional economies rather than external trading as the best guide for understanding pre‐modern development, as opposed to world‐systems theories, but it also aims to show in detail why it was that the pepper trade had relatively little impact on its producer region. Kerala was the only source of pepper for the whole Eurasian world until the late Middle Ages. This article argues that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance, and discusses why.

title: Work from Home and Disability Employment
title_zh: 居家办公与残疾人就业
authors: Nicholas Bloom, Gordon B. Dahl, Dan-Olof Rooth
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：Crossref
abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic, while work from home (WFH) has risen fourfold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0 percent for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68–85 percent of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggest that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions. official: 官方在线 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract We provide quasi-experimental evidence of the effects of municipal budget rules on the level of local economic activity exploiting the fact that, in 1999, the Italian government imposed a balanced-budget fiscal rule on all municipal governments but in 2001 exempted municipalities below 5,000 inhabitants. Municipalities which remained subject to budget rules increased taxes but also experienced a significant increase in the number of firms and workers. The increase in taxes was largely financed through issuing more building permits, which led to higher urban revenues. To support the claim that building permits is a plausible mechanism which attracts more firms, in the face of higher taxes, we show that the positive impact of budget rules on employment growth and firms’ entry is concentrated in municipalities with no physical constraints to urban planning and development. (JEL D73, H72, R52, R31, R33)
